def fn(x):
    def atbash(ch):
        if 'a' <= ch <= 'z':
            return chr(ord('a') + (25 - (ord(ch) - ord('a'))))

            return chr(ord('A') + (25 - (ord(ch) - ord('A'))))
        return ch
    return ''.join(atbash(c) for c in x)
